_comment: Scrap (CR 8.3.32) is an OPTIONAL ADDITIONAL COST to play: banish an item or equipment from your graveyard. It was missing entirely, and the trigger read an invented FLAG_SET 'SCRAPPED_CARD'. The SCRAPPED condition is keyed to THIS card's slug because the text says 'if IT scrapped', not 'if you scrapped'. Scrap is authored as the CARD-LEVEL `cost` (a play-time additional cost) rather than a separate empty PLAY ability: an ability existing only to carry a cost has no effects, which is a no-op by the hygiene rule and rightly flagged. Card-level `cost` compiles to play_cost, which engine/play.py checks and pays.
